patterns: Very thin PYQ base: APPSC asked only a scheme fact (BRGF merged into RGSA, Mains 2018).
Exam-relevant hard facts are Article numbers (243G/W, 243K, 243ZD/ZE), schedule counts (29/18) and RGSA funding/timeline.
Older PSC items test general features of local government (one-third women reservation, SEC conducting polls).
App leans on analytical 3F/parallel-body statements and 2026 AP cabinet and 16th FC current affairs; sound but far more discursive than PYQs.
